records.reuseInstructions: Full-strength D-76 may be reused with time compensation: Kodak specifies increasing development time by 15% after every four rolls per US gallon processed. It can also be replenished with D-76R. D-76 diluted 1+1 must be mixed just before use and discarded after one batch; do not reuse or replenish 1+1.
records.sourceTitle: KODAK Developer D-76 Technical Data J-78

records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate with water immediately before use; the FOMA technical sheet documents 1+25 and 1+50 as recommended working dilutions.
records.reuseInstructions: FOMA explicitly describes R09 as a one-shot developer. Prepare the diluted solution immediately before use and discard it after processing.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Concentrate remains usable for at least 6 months after opening when the screw top is tightly closed.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Diluted working solution has only a short keeping time and should be mixed immediately before use.
records.storageNotes: Keep concentrate in the closed package before dilution to limit oxidation; normal storage temperature 10-25 C.

records.productName: B&W PROMICROL Fine Grain Film Developer
records.capacityText: In replenished 1+9 use, replenish at 300 ml per square metre of processed film: 17 ml per 135-36, 15 ml per 120, 30 ml per 220, 4 ml per 4x5 sheet and 16 ml per 8x10 sheet. One-shot use is at 1+14.
records.sourceTitle: Champion B&W PROMICROL Fine Grain Film Developer Technical Data Sheet

records.preparation: Prepare 500 ml working solution from 50 ml concentrate and water, dilution 1+9.
records.reuseInstructions: A 500 ml working solution may process two 35mm or two 120 films one after another. Increase development time by 10-15% for the second roll.
records.capacityText: 500 ml working solution processes two 35mm or 120 films sequentially; the 100 ml concentrate bottle therefore processes four films total.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution stored in a completely filled air-free glass bottle keeps for 4 weeks.
records.storageNotes: ADOX recommends protective gas or squeezing the concentrate bottle so no air remains after partial use.
records.sourceTitle: ADOX CMS 20 and ADOTECH III Processing Instructions

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate 1+14 with water for use with ADOX CMS 20 II.
records.reuseInstructions: ADOX describes ADOTECH IV as an easy-to-use one-shot developer.
records.capacityText: 100 ml concentrate makes about 1500 ml working solution and is sufficient for up to six 35mm or 120 films.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Diluted ADOTECH IV keeps up to 14 days in completely filled bottles; refrigeration can extend working-solution life.
records.storageNotes: Do not refrigerate the concentrate because precipitation may occur; do not store concentrate below about 11-13 C.
records.sourceTitle: ADOX ADOTECH IV / CMS 20 II manufacturer data sheet

records.physicalState: powder developer; Kodak also supplied a liquid form
records.preparation: Use the prepared stock solution full strength, or dilute stock 1+3 immediately before processing. Kodak instructs that 1+3 is prepared just before use and discarded after that batch.
records.sourceTitle: KODAK MICRODOL-X Developer Technical Data J-4027 and Kodak B&W Darkroom Dataguide AJ-3
